nar.text: Sunday came with a blue sky and excellent weather.
An impressive field of 32 cars lined up at the grid, class by class with the biggest cars first, the order in the class decided by ballot.

Etancelin took it easy on the last lap while Czaykowski was really pushing, just in case something would happen to the leader, making the first sub-eleven minute lap of the race with a time of 10m58s.

Still there was a 73 seconds difference to the winner at the flag, Etancelin taking his Monza to victory in an excellent race followed by six Bugattis: Czaykowski, Lehoux, Zehender, Giraud-Cabantous, Gaupillat and Lormand.
